verdict.rationale: The Gateway supports automatic failover, retries, and provider ordering/sorting (docs-3, docs-9, docs-10, docs-13) which can mitigate a single provider's rate limits by shifting traffic to others, and BYOK lets you pass different credentials per request (docs-27). However, there is no documented mechanism for spreading load across multiple keys for the same provider or for explicit request queuing/throttling to smooth rate limits.
